description: This PHP file defines the 'LeavePeriodHistory' class, an entity used within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It maps to the 'ohrm_leave_period_history' database table and includes properties such as start month, start day, and creation date, along with getter and setter methods. The class also uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database interactions and a trait for decoration.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistory
classes.description: An ORM entity representing historical records of leave periods, including start month, start day, and creation timestamp, used within the OrangeHRM system for HR leave management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave period history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the record.

methods.name: getStartMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartMonth
methods.description: Sets the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Retrieves the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartDay
methods.description: Sets the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when this record was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for this record.
